COD.rationale: Content coordinates and separate origin/organization metadata are both explicitly present for the same referents/times.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linking to presentation/access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content tokens identify colored items and their coordinates for current and candidate times.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the content coordinates for the same referent, distinguishing identification from provenance/organization.

O.rationale: The report states layout rules and groups coordinates into named nodes/candidates, specifying how content is organized/presented.
